comment: Accepted answers per card. A card is correct when (tier, effort, deployment) matches at least one entry of `accept` (each entry is a product of its value lists), binding_constraint equals the key and reason is a non-empty string of at most 200 characters. Effort guidance: platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/effort, checked 2026-10-27.

offline-audit.why: Code may not leave the laptop, so local is the only option; the card offers 64 GB and a GPU, so a large local model is a reasonable reading too; effort is relaxed (time unlimited) but xhigh/max are not justified for a good-review bar.

ide-hint.why: Under 2 s for a one-line answer: a fast tier at low effort; local is ruled out by the card (10+ s).

ticket-triage.why: 10k runs/day under a small fixed budget, simple classification: Haiku-class; effort page: Haiku medium by default, low for simple high-volume work. No own hardware, so not local.

log-dump.why: 700k tokens cannot be split; every tier in the snapshot has a 1M window, so context rules out local (small windows) but does not require a larger tier; the task is mechanical.

core-refactor.why: Quality decides, budget and time relaxed. Fable 5.1 starts at high and steps up to xhigh/max for the most capability-sensitive coding work. Opus 5.5 defaults to medium and the docs ask for an effort sweep, so every level from its default up is defensible. frontier+medium is not accepted: below Fable's own starting level.

bulk-rename.why: Simple mechanical step run thousands of times under a small budget: Haiku-class at low or its default medium; CI runners, so cloud.
